The '''Utapaun Committee''' was the governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. Composed of various [[Port Administrator/Legends|Port Administrators]], the Committee elected the office of [[Chairman of Utapau/Legends|Master of Port Administration]], alternatively known as [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of Utapau, to serve as their [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]].
